crossRefs.note: They will not lie with the mighty who are fallen of the uncircumcised, who have gone down to Sheol with their weapons…
They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.
For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations…
I have cut off nations. Their battlements are desolate. I have made their streets waste, so that no one passes by.…
Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed…
It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person…

translations.web: “For I have put his terror in the land of the living. He will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude,” says the Lord Yahweh.
translations.bsb: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
translations.kjv: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
translations.asv: For I have put his terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord Jehovah.
